jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BESTOW

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov http://e-verify.gov.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Bestow Product organization is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering exceptional digital experiences that solve real problems. We collaborate across Engineering, Revenue and Ops teams to transform ideas into intuitive, valuable solutions that delight our users.

Within the Product team, we have three functions – Product Management, Design, and Product Operations–all reporting into our CTO.  The first two are the powerhouse team that plan and design our software solutions.  Our Product Ops team is the force multiplier–enabling Product Managers and Designers to make the best decisions and do their best work.

This is a high-visibility/high-impact role.  So we're looking for a highly motivated, technologically savvy, and AI-minded Senior Product Operations Manager to join our team and help take our Product organization to the next level!

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Operations & Strategy, and is open to hybrid in our Dallas office or Remote (US). #LIREMOTE




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Two primary responsibilities.

First, lead ongoing improvements to the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) — the processes, rituals, and tooling Product Managers rely on every day — in direct support of Product Management leadership and its goal of maximizing team output and product quality. [High Impact]

Second, own the product roadmap: the tooling systems, infrastructure, and governance that keep our roadmap complete, accurate, and visible to every stakeholder who depends on it.  [High Visibility]

To achieve both, we need someone with deep experience architecting and engineering the roadmap infrastructure in Jira and associated AI context layers– producing always accurate roadmaps via beautiful, interactive AI dashboards to showcase and promote our roadmap.

So this is way more than simply an administrator function.  A strong candidate possesses the knowledge and experience to architect JPD/Jira AND AI infrastructure (e.g., integrations, context layers, skills, etc.).

 - Important: You will NOT be inheriting a playbook — you'll be writing one!  This is a rare opportunity to shape what world-class product roadmap management looks like at an AI-native company, so we’re looking for someone with preexisting AI expertise and eagerness to contribute!

Your responsibilities will include:

 1. Owning, designing & improving PM Workflows within the Product Lifecycle process
    
    1. Partner directly with Product Management leadership to identify bottlenecks and friction in the PDLC and design solutions that improve PM velocity, quality, and consistency.
    
    2. Own and evolve the PDLC stages PMs operate within, ensuring hand-offs (especially Discovery → Software) are clean and consistently followed.
    
    3. Build and maintain "ready-to-develop & prioritized" backlog standards, and help enforce PRD quality before products move into development.
    
    4. Lead process enablement: templates, playbooks, RACI, and rituals that scale with the team.
    
    5. Architect and maintain our product operations technical stack, engineering robust configurations in Jira/Confluence and developing automated system integrations.
    
    6. Identify and implement AI-powered tools and workflows that meaningfully speed up PM work — requirements drafting, backlog grooming, synthesis of customer insight — with an eye toward measurable efficiency gains.

 2. Owning the Product Roadmap
    
    1. Be the operational owner of the product roadmap — building the systems and infrastructure (Jira, Confluence, dashboards) that keep it structured, current, and trustworthy.
    
    2. Establish governance standards for roadmap data (date confidence levels, field hygiene, update cadence) across all PMs.
    
    3. Ensure the roadmap is complete, accurate, and easily accessible to key stakeholders.
    
    4. Build reporting/dashboards giving leadership visibility into roadmap health and delivery risk via native Jira dashboards and new AI-built dashboards.
    
    5. Collaborate with TPM and Implementation Managers to ensure release operations are delivering on our roadmap commitments to customers.
    
    6. Work with technical communications, PMs, and Product Marketers to ensure that processes supporting release communications are completed in a timely manner IAW product release and launch timetables.

 3. Driving Product Team Meetings & Engagement
    
    1. Work with Product leadership to plan and facilitate team-wide events (e.g., product all-hands, onsites, monthly product reviews, etc.), handling logistics and coordination so the team can focus on the content and connection.
    
    2. Own the function-specific onboarding experience for new product managers
    
    3. Administratively support the product management leadership team.

 4. Reporting & Continuous Improvement
    
    1. Define and track metrics on Product team performance and process health.
    
    2. Provide Product leadership regular visibility into capacity and process health.
    
    3. Stay current on industry-leading Product Ops practices and AI-powered tooling.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Highly organized with a strong attention to detail, without losing sight of the big picture.

 - Systems thinker — able to track a number of high-level views of work while still being able to speak to granular details.

 - Compulsive about removing process friction — you can't walk past a broken workflow without wanting to fix it.

 - AI-Native Architect - You don't just use AI; you fundamentally rethink workflows by replacing legacy manual steps with AI-driven, automated processes.

 - Comfortable in a fast-moving, startup environment where priorities shift and resourcefulness is essential.

 - Intense curiosity and dedication towards evolving daily product management practices through substantial industry evolution.

 - A natural partner to Product Management leadership — you measure your own success by how much more effective you make their team.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor's degree or higher

 - Minimum 5+ years of experience in product operations, product management, or similar roles within high-growth tech companies

 - Extensive experience with product management and collaboration tools:
   
   - Must have:  Jira/Confluence, Claude (or other leading AI system)
   
   - Good to have:  Jira Product Discovery, Cursor, Notion

 - Proven track record of implementing and optimizing product development processes, metrics frameworks, and operational systems that drive efficiency and quality

 - Experience with agile methodologies and the ability to adapt processes to fit different team needs while maintaining organizational alignment

 - Experience leading or actively contributing to a team's shift toward AI-native ways of working — identifying where AI genuinely changes the shape of a workflow versus where it's just noise, and helping a team adopt it with real discipline.

 - Outstanding communication and stakeholder management abilities, with experience influencing cross-functional teams and executive leadership

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

 - Experience with resource planning, capacity management, and budgeting processes to optimize team efficiency and product delivery

 - Possess a strong data-driven approach to product operations having developed metrics, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into product performance and team effectiveness
   
   


TOTAL REWARDS

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits for full-time employees include:

 - Competitive salary and equity based on role

 - Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs

 - 100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing

 - Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote

 - Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting

 - Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards include:

 - Best Place for Working Parents 2023 + 2024 + 2025

 - Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025

 - Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025

 - Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023

 - Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

Thanks for considering a job at Bestow!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Bestow is the leading platform for life and annuity carriers, and we're scaling fast.

The Director of Product Marketing sets platform positioning strategy and leads go-to-market for Bestow's most important launches, working closely with the CMO, executive team, and stakeholders across the business to shape how the company's innovation narrative evolves alongside the business. You'll build strong partnerships across Product, Sales, and Communications, bringing each function along early and turning competing priorities into a single, clear story the whole company can execute against.

You'll have real autonomy to set direction and real influence over how leadership thinks about market strategy. If you want to shape both the narrative and the cross-functional muscle behind it at a company in a high-growth phase, this is the role.

This role reports to the CMO and is open to hybrid in our Dallas office or Remote (US). #LIRemote




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Bestow's platform positioning and messaging strategy, and be the senior voice on how that story evolves as the product, market, and competitive landscape shift.

 - Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for major launches, making the final call on sequencing and priorities across Product, Sales, Communications, and Marketing.

 - Build proactive, trusted partnerships across Product, Sales, and Communications, aligning stakeholders early so launches and narratives move fast without last-minute scrambles.

 - Set the strategy and quality bar for sales enablement, pitch decks, battle cards, and competitive intelligence, and build the team and process to maintain it at scale.

 - Bring market, buyer, and competitive insight into executive conversations, influencing roadmap, positioning, and business strategy decisions.

 - Own the measurement framework connecting product marketing to pipeline and win rates, using it to guide investment and resourcing.

 - Grow the product marketing function over time, bringing on and developing team members as Bestow's needs scale.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Significant product marketing experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology at a senior/leadership level, with a track record of increasing scope.

 - A trusted strategic partner to executives and cross-functional stakeholders, comfortable shaping company-level narrative and GTM decisions, not just executing on them.

 - A compelling storyteller who can take a complex, technical platform and make it land clearly with a sophisticated enterprise audience.

 - Strong positioning and launch instincts, setting direction from ambiguity and driving it through execution with minimal oversight.

 - Experience building and scaling both sales enablement and a product marketing team.

 - Experience in fintech, insurtech, or a platform business is a strong plus.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and fluency using AI tools to accelerate research, content, and GTM speed.
